capabilities: List Microsoft To Do tasks in a sidebar by list or by date
Drag a task into a note as an indented Markdown task line
Mark tasks the active note already contains
Search and filter tasks by title, note, list, due date and status
Jump from a note line to its task in the panel
extras: Read-only: it never creates, changes or completes tasks in To Do. Requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or newer for secret storage; the sign-in token is kept there per vault and device, and fetched lists are cached in local storage.
motivation: Microsoft To Do itself does not let you drag tasks into other apps, so the drag starts in this panel instead.
problem: Microsoft To Do cannot drag tasks into other apps, and Obsidian gives no view of To Do tasks or of which ones a note already contains.

relations.evidence: A sidebar in Obsidian that lists your Microsoft To Do tasks.

requires.name: Microsoft account with Microsoft To Do
Microsoft Entra app registration (client ID and tenant)

summary: Sidebar that lists Microsoft To Do tasks and drags them into notes as Markdown task lines, marking the ones a note already holds.
